window_rationale: EU DST end 2024-10-27 + US DST end 2024-11-03 + two weekend rollovers, bounded 11 days from 2024 (plan 5.2 probe spec)

candle_scale_check.note: candle/tick raw magnitudes share the one scale; medians recorded

sundays.note: EU DST end (CEST->CET): FX Sunday-open hour tracks US DST, so this Sunday still opens ~21:00 UTC; the shift to ~22:00 UTC appears at the US transition
US DST end (EDT->EST): FX Sunday open moves from ~21:00 to ~22:00 UTC from this date

band_derivation.method: union(probe min*0.80 floor-to-pip, probe max*1.20 ceil-to-pip, registered guard)
